decision: The exact official LuckyHDR repository contains one bounded checkpoint and one explicit short/mid/long iPhone ProRAW bracket suitable for a separately frozen private runtime D0. The audit does not open acquisition or execution because demo-capture redistribution and upstream SI-HDR training-data rights are not fixed for product use.
preformal_exclusions: The first Python urllib attempt stopped on a TLS handshake before any report or bound object was read.
A second urllib attempt read only the exact commit response before a tree-request TLS failure; it produced no report.
A filtered Git diagnostic stopped on the initial Schannel TLS request and produced no source checkout.
Before any formal report, the transport was prospectively amended to bounded curl HTTP/1.1 retries without changing repository objects, roles, limits, gates or interpretation.
claim_ceiling: Private zero-pixel source feasibility for one exact LuckyHDR checkpoint and one exact bundled three-frame ProRAW bracket only; no HDR ground truth or quality, arbitrary bracket, redistribution/commercial rights, package/schema/capability/product admission or candidate3.
